caption: The drawing depicts a double-pan balance scale, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The scale is rendered in shades of gray and brown, suggesting a metallic material. It consists of a wide, sturdy base with a rounded, flared bottom and a vertically oriented, short cylindrical pedestal at the center. Two symmetrical arms extend horizontally from the central axis, each holding a shallow circular pan. Each pan is supported by a curved, decorative bracket resembling a heart shape, which connects to the outer ends of the horizontal arms and descends to smaller, rounded feet on either side. The drawing’s only visible text appears at the lower right and reads "Geo. V. Vezolles." There are no other objects, markings, or embellishments on the otherwise blank background.
title: Shaker Scales
